title: Data-Driven Hull-Fouling Cleaning Schedule Optimization to Reduce Carbon Footprint of Vessels
summary: In response to climate change, the International Maritime Organization has introduced regulations to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from international shipping. Compliance with these regulations is increasingly expected from individual shipping companies and can be achieved through more frequent hull and propeller cleanings. Since this maintenance work entails high costs, vessel operators are confronted with the trade-off between lower fleet emissions and better economic performance.
